rows.what the ink shows: The initial μ retains a long left downstroke and joined shallow bowl. The following strokes are crossed through at baseline: an upright, lower loop and low end humps survive, but they do not distinguish the proposed words étant une.

A small initial curved remnant, a central upright, a later raised dot and a final shoulder survive above the cancellation. The bar masks the intervening baseline letters; comparison with the uncancelled certain on this page does not recover the whole word securely.
There are only two compact letter units: a flattened m stroke followed by the upright and rightward hooked foot of b. No further e, r or e strokes occur before est.

The first short unit retains the loop and low joining stroke of de. The following word has two surviving uprights, but double cancellation conceals its intervening bowls and ending; toutes remains plausible without being distinguished.

Below familles, the cancelled word retains an initial descending hook and a central upright crossing the bar, followed by a small raised shoulder. The baseline is densely overdrawn, so the letters needed to establish parties cannot be separately recovered.

An initial upright hook and two later tall strokes survive above the deletion rule. Their spacing resembles the uncancelled sommable inserted above, but the long heavy rule hides the low intervening letters and prevents a certain full reading.
A tall left spine joins three rightward arms, with the lower arm descending slightly; the shape is a standalone capital E.

The deleted group under the beginning of retrouve is reduced to dark bumps along the cancellation stroke and a diagonal stroke below it. Neither a separate o loop nor a complete n arch can be distinguished.
The opening tall l and its detached apostrophe remain clear. A low loop/descender and a later upward hook survive, but the thick cancellation covers the sequence needed to distinguish espace des.

A small upturn at the left and short raised strokes with a detached dot near the right survive above the heavy deletion. The central letter bodies are buried in the rule, so the full sequence mais cannot be confirmed.
